description: This file defines various enumerations, structs, and a class actor concerned with execution approvals and security policies in a macOS application. It manages allowlists, approval decisions, security settings, and handles file I/O for storing and resolving approval configurations.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: An actor class responsible for caching and managing the list of available skill binaries and their trust paths, refreshing periodically, and providing resolution functions.

classes.name: ExecEventPayload
classes.description: A data structure representing payload for execution event logging, including session info, command output, and status.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves execution approval configuration for a given agent ID, loading from file or defaults.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the current exec approvals configuration to disk, ensuring secure permissions.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads the exec approvals configuration from disk.

methods.name: ensureFile
methods.description: Ensures the configuration file exists, creating default if necessary, then loads and normalizes it.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Normalizes and validates allowlist entries, optionally dropping invalid ones.

methods.name: validateAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Validates that a pattern is suitable for allowlist use, ensuring it contains path components.
